item.title: [Ada Derana Biz English] Where Passion Meets Teamwork:Technocity | Lenovo Premier League 2026 Brings Sri Lanka’s IT Community Together
item.description:
Sri Lanka’s technology industry traded keyboards for cricket bats as the Technocity | Lenovo Premier League 2026 (TLPL 2026) brought together 18 leading companies from the country’s IT sector for a memorable day of competitive cricket and camaraderie.
More than a corporate cricket tournament, TLPL 2026 was created as a platform to bring together people from across Sri Lanka’s technology ecosystem -not only business owners and managers but employees representing their different organizations.
